scope_limitations: Handover inventory, consumable expiry, suitable replacements and secure storage; not fitted tyre tread/age/sidewall or condition certification.
No universal spare requirement, repairable puncture size, travel distance or speed.
Toyota historical guidance and specified Mazda CX-30 manual are scoped examples, not current universal product rules.
No roadside repair procedure; temporary mobility is not permanent repair.
numeric_token_method: Strip URL strings before comparing numeric tokens; review month-number and Han-numeral equivalences semantically. Product identity CX-30 and TIGGO 9 are not performance claims.
image_status: ALT and caption describe intended three-box editorial schematic; parent supplies and verifies actual asset and rights. Not a photographed or inspected vehicle.
similarity_scope: Measured full-body same-language five-gram Jaccard between these two assigned articles only; parent handles batch and historical corpus comparison. No exhaustive live-site dedup claim.
rule_conflicts_resolved: Current writer brief delegates repository synchronization and commit to parent; no local git pull, commit or deployment performed.
Current task authorizes qualitative vehicle writing under conditional research, excluding blocked specifications.
